product.olivetti-echos-pro-166xm.summary: The Echos Pro 166XM expanded the high-end line with a 3 GB disk and integrated audio.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-166xm.history: Computerwoche covered the Pro 166XM in March 1997 as a high-end addition and reported a price of around DM 9,000.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-166xm.archite: Integrated audio supported recording and playback. The offer lists speakers, a microphone and a 10× CD-ROM.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-166xm.verifie: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-166xm.limitat: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-166xm.press: Computerwoche, 28 March 1997, Olivetti startet mit neuer Führung.
